verses.english: Numbered Discourses 8.69
7. Earthquakes
Assemblies
“Mendicants, there are these eight assemblies.
What eight?

verses.pali: Khattiyaparisā, brāhmaṇaparisā, gahapatiparisā, samaṇaparisā, cātumahārājikaparisā, tāvatiṁsaparisā, māraparisā, brahmaparisā.
verses.english: The assemblies of aristocrats, brahmins, householders, and ascetics. An assembly of the gods of the four great kings. An assembly of the gods of the thirty-three. An assembly of Māras. An assembly of divinities.

verses.pali: Abhijānāmi kho panāhaṁ, bhikkhave, anekasataṁ khattiyaparisaṁ upasaṅkamitā.
verses.english: I recall having approached an assembly of hundreds of aristocrats.

verses.pali: Tatrapi mayā sannisinnapubbañceva sallapitapubbañca sākacchā ca samāpannapubbā.
verses.english: There I used to sit with them, converse, and engage in discussion.

verses.pali: Tattha yādisako tesaṁ vaṇṇo hoti tādisako mayhaṁ vaṇṇo hoti, yādisako tesaṁ saro hoti tādisako mayhaṁ saro hoti.
verses.english: And my appearance and voice became just like theirs.

verses.pali: Dhammiyā ca kathāya sandassemi samādapemi samuttejemi sampahaṁsemi.
verses.english: I educated, encouraged, fired up, and inspired them with a Dhamma talk.
But when I spoke they didn’t know:

verses.pali: ‘ko nu kho ayaṁ bhāsati devo vā manusso vā’ti.
verses.english: ‘Who is this that speaks? Is it a god or a human?’

verses.pali: Dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṁsetvā antaradhāyāmi.
verses.english: And when my Dhamma talk was finished I vanished.
But when I vanished they didn’t know:

verses.pali: ‘ko nu kho ayaṁ antarahito devo vā manusso vā’ti.
verses.english: ‘Who was that who vanished? Was it a god or a human?’

These are the eight assemblies.”
